title: Reimbursements of infrastructure hosting costs {Nov 2022 - Feb 2023}
body:
This proposal aims to distinguish the periodic hosting costs from other SCU contributions. So moving forward, we will see 2 different types of SCU proposals (The conventional one and this new one for the hosting costs).

## Contributors Involved:
**JelliedOwl**
- JelliedOwl is currently hosting geo-aware load-balanced RPC infrastructure (which is majorly used in PolkadotApps, EdgeApps, different wallets and block explorers for substrate/EdgeWASM and EdgeEVM environments). 
- Their previously approved proposal for the same:

> [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6607-public-rpc-and-bootnodes-jelliedowl](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6607-public-rpc-and-bootnodes-jelliedowl)
- Previous hosting reimbursements per month: 3000 GBP equivalent in EDG
- Downscaled hosting reimbursements per month: 500 GBP equivalent in EDG (~600 USD equivalent in EDG)


**Bharathcoorg**
- Bharathcoorg is currently hosting block explorers of EdgeEVM/BeresheetEVM, Edgeverse extension & mobile wallet, Edgeverse DEX and Edgeverse Bridge portal.
- Their previously approved (related) proposals:

> [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4214-builders-program-application-blockexplorer-and-wallet/](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4214-builders-program-application-blockexplorer-and-wallet/)
> [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/8013-proposal-basic-evm-tools-for-edgeware-network/](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/8013-proposal-basic-evm-tools-for-edgeware-network/)
- Previous hosting reimbursements per month: 1000 USD equivalent in EDG
- Downscaled hosting reimbursements per month: 500 USD equivalent in EDG



**Combined reimbursements of the hosting costs:** 1100 USD equivalent in EDG per month

**Proposal period: **Nov 2022 - Feb 2023

This proposal will be raised monthly moving forward.


- **Trailing median of Nov 2022: **0.000531 USD per EDG
- **Reimbursements for Nov 2022: **2071563.09 EDG


- **Trailing median of Dec 2022: **0.000425 USD per EDG
- **Reimbursements for Dec 2022: **2588235.29 EDG
